title: H^n-measure of a closed ball in R^n equals omega_n r^n
statement:
For every n >= 1, every c in R^n = EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) and every r >= 0, the normalised n-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the closed ball satisfies H^n(B_r(c)) = omega_n r^n.
- Here H^n = muHE[n] on R^n, B_r(c) = closedBall c r, and omega_n = unitBallVolume n = pi^(n/2)/Gamma(n/2 + 1).
- As an extended real: muHE[n](closedBall c r) = ENNReal.ofReal(omega_n * r^n).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (c : Rn n) (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Rn n)) (closedBall c r) = ENNReal.ofReal (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)
